title: Create a Price Stabilisation Fund
assessment_rule: Verify establishment, funding and subsequent operation
finding: A Price Stabilisation Fund for agricultural commodities was established in 2014–15 and funded. Establishment is verified; whether it prevented price spikes over time is a separate impact question.

title: Introduce stronger anti-hoarding measures and special courts
assessment_rule: Document central legislation, rules and functioning of courts
finding: A July 2014 ministry response announced proposed anti-hoarding provisions and special courts; government guidance notes states may constitute special courts. There is insufficient state-level implementation evidence to conclude the entire commitment was delivered.

title: Reorganise Food Corporation of India procurement, storage and distribution
assessment_rule: Check organisational reform against proposed separation

title: Provide farmers real-time information about produce prices and stocks
assessment_rule: Identify public delivery system and accessibility

title: Create a single National Agriculture Market
assessment_rule: Verify establishment separately from national market integration
finding: e-NAM was launched in April 2016, establishing a common digital platform for participating agricultural markets. NITI Aayog and a scholarly assessment document practical barriers to trading across mandis. Existence of the portal is established; a single fully integrated market and resulting price gains are not established by launch.

title: Support locally suitable crop and vegetable cultivation
assessment_rule: Identify operational programme, coverage and supporting data

title: Develop labour-intensive manufacturing and tourism for employment
assessment_rule: Assess programmes and employment trends separately

title: Offer credit and incubation support for youth self-employment
assessment_rule: Confirm programme launch, uptake and sustainability

title: Introduce multi-skills development in mission mode
assessment_rule: Confirm schemes and independently assessed outcomes
finding: The National Skill Development Mission was launched on 15 July 2015. National training and job outcomes are not established by this launch alone.

title: Convert employment exchanges into career centres
assessment_rule: Confirm conversion counts and operational access
finding: The National Career Service online portal was launched in July 2015 and a Model Career Centres programme was pursued. Employment placement outcomes are not established by portal activity figures.

title: Prioritise open, transparent and accountable administration
assessment_rule: Define indicators before any verdict

title: Consult other parties on simultaneous Assembly and Lok Sabha elections
assessment_rule: Check parliamentary or consultation record; no universal deadline

title: Expand village broadband penetration
assessment_rule: Track rural subscriptions and quality of access

title: Use technology and social media for participatory governance and grievances
assessment_rule: Audit grievance systems and response quality

title: Create IT-based jobs in rural and semi-urban areas
assessment_rule: Track employment series and documented programme interventions

title: Expand the National e-Governance Plan through government offices
assessment_rule: Define office coverage and practical use

title: Promote e-Bhasha for Indian-language computing
assessment_rule: Check programme creation and language coverage

title: Launch a national digital-literacy programme
assessment_rule: Track programme launch, completion and independent literacy surveys
finding: A rural national digital-literacy scheme operated; by March 2024 the government counted 6.39 crore trained, but only 4.78 crore certified. Do not present training as proof of durable literacy.

title: Increase public spending on education to 6% of GDP
assessment_rule: Define Centre+states, annual actual spending and denominator

title: Work towards universal secondary schooling
assessment_rule: Gross and net enrolment and completion series

title: Establish a national e-library for students and teachers
assessment_rule: Verify launch and functional utilisation
finding: The National Digital Library of India was launched in June 2018. This establishes a digital library platform, but does not establish its educational impact or universal access.

title: Strengthen teacher training and address faculty shortages
assessment_rule: Track vacancies, training and learning outcomes

title: Introduce a new national health policy
assessment_rule: Evidence of formal policy approval
finding: National Health Policy 2017 approved. Administrative delivery distinct from stated ambition of affordable universal care.

title: Initiate a National Health Assurance Mission
assessment_rule: Do not equate targeted insurance with universal health assurance

title: Establish an AIIMS-like institute in every state
assessment_rule: Count state coverage, not merely number of AIIMS
finding: The government began planning AIIMS-like institutes in every state. A 2026 health ministry account reports 22 newly approved AIIMS, of which 18 were fully functional; a state-by-state mapping of operational institutions remains necessary.

title: Establish a national eHealth authority
assessment_rule: Verify legal creation and operational powers

title: Provide piped water connection to every household by 2024
assessment_rule: Compare original all-household pledge with rural JJM coverage and national urban/rural data
finding: The 2019 manifesto specified universal household piped water by 2024. Ministry reports 80.38% rural coverage as of March 2025, establishing that the universal goal was not met by the original deadline. Nonetheless, many new rural connections were created; implementation involves states and the Union.

title: Reach US$5 trillion nominal GDP by 2025
assessment_rule: Calendar-2025 GDP current US$ vs 5e12; disclose FY/calendar ambiguity
finding: World Bank WDI calendar-year nominal GDP 2025 US$3.956 trillion vs US$5 trillion target. GDP growth and exchange-rate shifts are not synonymous with target fulfillment.

title: Reach US$10 trillion nominal GDP by 2032
assessment_rule: Calendar-2032 GDP current US$ vs 10e12
finding: Future deadline; not graded.

title: Become the world’s third-largest economy by 2030
assessment_rule: Compare nominal GDP country rank under same source
finding: The manifesto target has a 2030 deadline. Evaluation is premature.

title: Mobilise ₹100 lakh crore for infrastructure investment by 2024
assessment_rule: Confirm cumulative investment definition and government/private funding

title: Continue simplifying the Goods and Services Tax system
assessment_rule: Track rule changes and independent compliance-cost surveys

title: Move India into top 50 of World Bank Doing Business ranking
assessment_rule: Original index has been discontinued; do not use substitute index
finding: India reached rank 63 in the last World Bank Doing Business edition (2020), not the pledged top 50. The World Bank discontinued the index in 2021, so no subsequent top-50 ranking could be measured; classify as discontinued measure, not a deadline failure.

title: Introduce a new industrial policy
assessment_rule: Verify a formally notified central industrial policy

title: Amend Companies Act for civil treatment of minor technical violations
assessment_rule: Check legal amendments and effective dates

title: Make efforts to double farmers’ incomes by 2022
assessment_rule: Baseline and income concept not stipulated; compare real/nominal income carefully
finding: No fully comparable observed 2022 farm-household income series has been verified in this release; do not infer success or failure.

title: Launch a pension scheme for small and marginal farmers
assessment_rule: Verify scheme launch, eligibility and enrolment separately
finding: The voluntary contributory PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana for eligible small and marginal farmers launched in September 2019. Implementation does not prove universal uptake or adequate pensions.

title: Support MSME competitiveness and employment-generating industrial clusters
assessment_rule: Check measures and independent jobs evidence

title: Improve student learning outcomes through teacher capacity building
assessment_rule: Comparable learning surveys and access measures

title: Pursue removal of Article 370 provisions for Jammu and Kashmir
assessment_rule: Check enacted constitutional actions and their legal status
finding: Constitutional measures were enacted in August 2019 concerning Article 370. This checks legal implementation only, not any asserted benefit or impact on civil liberties.

title: Enact the Citizenship Amendment Bill
assessment_rule: Verify enactment separately from administration or impacts
finding: Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019 passed and received assent in December 2019. Implementation and consequences should be assessed separately.

title: Build consensus for simultaneous national and state elections
assessment_rule: Consultation process not equal to enacted law

title: Work towards one common voter list across elections
assessment_rule: Verify enacted arrangements, not bills alone

title: Explore implementation of a Right to Service for public services
assessment_rule: Assess legal and operational delivery

title: Set up one medical or postgraduate medical college in every district by 2024
assessment_rule: Count districts with one such college under consistent definition
scope_note: Verified against BJP 2019 manifesto PDF page 23: the pledge specifies by 2024. Implementation remains unreviewed.

title: Set up 75 medical institutes by 2022
assessment_rule: Verify 75 institutes type and opening vs approvals

title: Provide full immunisation coverage for children and pregnant women by 2022
assessment_rule: Use compatible NFHS/administrative measures; distinguish doses/coverage

title: Eliminate tuberculosis in India by 2025
assessment_rule: WHO disease-burden indicators; zero vs elimination definition requires examination
finding: The WHO reports India still had a substantial tuberculosis burden in 2024. The manifesto target was elimination by 2025, but definitive same-year estimates and an agreed operational definition are needed before publishing a final 2025 outcome.

title: Connect each Gram Panchayat with high-speed optical fibre by 2022
assessment_rule: Distinguish fibre laid, active service and functional capacity
finding: The BJP pledged every gram panchayat high-speed optical-fibre connectivity by 2022. Only 177,550 GPs were service-ready by June 2022 and 214,283 by October 2024 (of roughly 264,000). The original deadline was not met, despite continuing expansion. Service readiness must not be presented as broadband usage.

title: Establish or develop a National Research Foundation
assessment_rule: Verify passage, notification and operational funding separately
finding: Anusandhan National Research Foundation Act enacted in August 2023, operational commencement February 2024. This verifies statutory establishment; not grants disbursed or research impact.

title: Expand broadband services for tele-education and telemedicine
assessment_rule: Measure actual effective access rather than announced coverage

title: Continue free food-grain support for eligible households for five years
assessment_rule: Verify programme operational status and beneficiary coverage; continuing obligation
finding: The five-year extension was authorised in November 2023, before the manifesto, and implementation continued during 2024. Final five-year pledge remains under way.

title: Expand action to stabilise prices of pulses, vegetables and edible oils
assessment_rule: Avoid attributing consumer inflation to one programme

title: Expand PM Awas Yojana access for poor families
assessment_rule: Compare house sanctions, completion and occupancy

title: Work towards India becoming the third-largest economy
assessment_rule: Manifesto gives no explicit year on this statement

title: Maintain macroeconomic stability, including growth and inflation
assessment_rule: Define transparent observable measures before evaluating

title: Promote exports and simplify commercial and tax law
assessment_rule: Exports, legislation and business costs should be evaluated separately

title: Strengthen manufacturing and production-linked incentive programmes
assessment_rule: Manufacturing share, productivity and programme evidence

title: Develop hostels and crèches to support working women
assessment_rule: Count operational facilities and independent access studies

title: Fill central vacancies transparently and in a time-bound way
assessment_rule: Recruitment time, vacancy trends and disclosure standards

title: Support gig-worker registration on e-Shram
assessment_rule: Registered vs eligible platform workers and benefits received

title: Expand PM SVANidhi access to more street vendors and small traders
assessment_rule: Registrations, loans, repeat borrowers, disbursements

title: Bring drivers onto e-Shram and social-security schemes
assessment_rule: Measure enrolment and delivered benefits

title: Raise MUDRA loan limit to ₹20 lakh
assessment_rule: Check loan programme notification and eligibility scope
finding: Tarun Plus ₹10–20 lakh eligibility took effect 24 October 2024, limited to borrowers who successfully repaid prior Tarun loans. It is a verified policy ceiling, not a universal entitlement or a measured rise in enterprise success.

title: Implement legal provisions for women’s representation in legislatures
assessment_rule: Distinguish enactment, commencement and elected representation

title: Make progress towards simultaneous elections
assessment_rule: Distinguish committee recommendations from constitutional implementation

title: Introduce a common electoral roll for all levels of elections
assessment_rule: Check enacted rules and nationwide implementation

title: Formulate a national litigation policy to reduce government court cases
assessment_rule: Verify formally issued policy and measurable litigation metrics

title: Strengthen public statistical institutions
assessment_rule: Independent review of statistical capacity, budgets and data availability

title: Extend Ayushman Bharat health coverage to senior citizens
assessment_rule: Policy launch vs universal enrollment and actual access
finding: Ayushman Bharat 70+ coverage was formally extended on 29 October 2024. Roughly 14 lakh cards were issued by 29 November 2024; enrolment, access and actual treatment outcomes are separate metrics.

title: Expand AIIMS network and improve access to healthcare
assessment_rule: Institution commissioning and access, not only announcement

title: Launch emergency and trauma care mission
assessment_rule: Formal launch and service delivery coverage

title: Operationalise a digital university offering industry-focused courses
assessment_rule: Verify actual teaching and accreditation

title: Increase capacity of higher learning institutions and medical seats
assessment_rule: Net seat increases, faculty and quality

title: Launch a focused effort to eliminate cervical cancer
assessment_rule: Specify prevention programme and assess vaccination/screening coverage

title: Operationalise the Anusandhan National Research Foundation
assessment_rule: Act, activation, staffing and actual research programmes
finding: The ANRF was legally established by the 2023 Act, but the 2024 promise concerns operationalisation. The law alone is insufficient to determine disbursements, operational governance and programme outcomes.

title: Set up ₹1 lakh crore fund to support research and innovation
assessment_rule: Separate authorised corpus from cash disbursements
finding: ₹1 lakh crore RDI Fund received Cabinet approval and implementing arrangements exist; full financing and disbursement not established.

title: Establish Bharatiya Antariksha Station and a second launch complex
assessment_rule: Planning, contracts and operational status separately

title: Strengthen IndiaAI innovation programmes
assessment_rule: Investment, deployment and independently evaluated outputs

title: Operationalise the National Quantum Mission
assessment_rule: Funding and completed programme milestones
finding: The National Quantum Mission is operating through four thematic hubs established in FY2024–25, with reported fund releases. This verifies the operational programme, not achievement of research or technology targets.

title: Use Bhashini to expand multilingual public services
assessment_rule: Number of live services and working language coverage
finding: Bhashini has an operational translation platform and 2026 ministry integration agreements, but agreements do not demonstrate nationwide multilingual availability or service quality.

title: Develop spaceflight capability through the Gaganyaan programme
assessment_rule: Human launch operation vs test missions; no manifesto date
